leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the ninth season of , Pokémon: Battle Frontier, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the ninth season of , Pokémon: Battle Frontier, in and ( ).

==Pokémon Season 9 Super Wallet==
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing Super Wallets to celebrate the .

The Season 9 Super Wallet was released by Magna Pacific (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on March 4, 2009. It contains 10 discs with 47 episodes across them combined, and one bonus disc with The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. Its catalogue number is DSW12994. Its discs are designed to resemble a Luxury Ball, except the bonus disc, which is designed to resemble a Premier Ball. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Contents===
 

==Season 9 disc set==
 
 
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010.

The Season 9 DigiPack disc set was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on March 2, 2011 and in New Zealand on May 12, 2011. It contains six discs with 47 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13191. Its discs are designed to resemble a Luxury Ball. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online on July 14, 2016 and in JB Hi-Fi stores on September 21, 2016 to celebrate the Pokémon 20th Anniversary. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5393.

This disc set was once again re-released by Shock Entertainment in Australia on June 2, 2021 and in New Zealand on July 21, 2021 with a different cover and the catalogue number KAL5660B.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. The featured Pokémon appears in at least one of the episodes on that disc, and is typically an important Pokémon in one of them.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Battle Frontier episodes.
Pokémon Kanto and Orange Islands Collection
Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Limited Edition Collection
Pokémon: Heritage Collection
Pokémon the Series: Kanto and Orange Islands - Limited Edition Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
